labels.variantDefinition: Colour-coded square tiles, one per alternate or stylistic set, each showing a single sample glyph with a tiny label, with short notes beside each group
labels.look: Light grey, staggered blue/orange/yellow/green squares (thin Ñ, circled 1, squared C, alternate a), then black video band and blue OpenType list
labels.ux: Mostly static; a looping video band; OpenType feature list below
labels.learn: One glyph per tile, colour-coded by set, makes a long list of alternates scannable in seconds

labels.variantDefinition: Small glyph grid (often grouped by script or category) beside a sticky large preview of one glyph drawn on its vertical metrics
labels.look: White, red 'Overview' and prose, subfamily × weight matrix of letter pairs, then ruled grids by script next to a big red ķ on metric lines
labels.ux: Hover a glyph to see it large on cap height, x-height, baseline; sticky Typetester/Purchase links
labels.learn: Pair a compact grid with one magnified glyph on its metrics: overview and close reading in the same view

labels.look: Black, five columns (Neon, Argon, Xenon, Radon, Krypton) each in its own pastel colour, words stepping through weights
labels.learn: Colour-code each sibling family so a superfamily reads as distinct voices that share one grid

labels.variantDefinition: Developer install instructions: package-manager command, framework code snippets with copy buttons, often a table comparing install methods
labels.look: White two-column docs layout, npm and Next.js code blocks with copy icons, feature-by-method table with check icons, .zip download
labels.ux: Copy commands and snippets; download .zip; links to README and licence
labels.learn: Compare install methods by what each one loses (features, glyphs): it saves support questions later

labels.look: Light blue, green lead-in 'Compressa is the perfect typeface for:', use cases in dark condensed type at varied sizes, each justified to one measure
labels.ux: static (sticky nav bar repeats in capture)
labels.learn: List the use cases in the font itself, each fitted to the same width: the pitch is also the size range demo

labels.look: White with dark red rules, licence-size cards (Mini…Testing), preview text field, full series package $150 Buy Now
labels.ux: Pick licence size, type preview text, choose package, buy
labels.learn: Recolour one checkout template per family so the shop stays familiar but on-brand for each release

labels.variantDefinition: The family's dimensions shown as columns of named stops (optical size, softness, weight, style); clicking a stop sets the sample, so the overview is also the tester
labels.look: Saffron field, white serif 'Thank You for Shopping With us!', thin-ruled columns Family/opsz/SOFT/WGHT/Style, 'Instance gratification' note
labels.ux: Click stops in each column to switch the instance; sample text editable
labels.learn: Lay out the design space as a clickable table of named stops: it explains the family and lets you drive it

labels.look: White, blue condensed 'Get Job Clarendon!', preorder note, blue-ruled licence-size cards, preview text field
labels.ux: Preorder with free upgrade; pick licence size, preview text, choose package
labels.learn: Sell an unfinished family as a preorder with a free upgrade to fund and test it in public

labels.variantDefinition: A full-width documentary photo of the designer at work (font editor, drawings, proofs) that humanises the making
labels.look: Studio photo: designer in glasses typing on a laptop showing 'OH' in a font editor, crumpled proof in front
labels.learn: One candid studio photo of the font editor shows craft and a real person behind a free font
